# Sheet

A panel that slides in from an edge.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-sheet--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Sheet examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-sheet--docs">Open Sheet in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-sheet--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** The menu on a phone.

- **Use it when:** Filters, details or a secondary form while the page stays in view.
- **Not when:** A blocking decision (dialog), or a tiny confirmation.

Instead:

- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A centered blocking window.
- [Drawer](./drawer.md): The bottom panel for phones.

## How Multi-brand uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A menu or dialog</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> elevation.overlay and a dimmed page</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> No shadow</div></div><div class="cap">The shadow shows a menu or dialog floats above the page. Without it, it blends into the cards.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape closes it. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It behaves as a dialog: named, focus moves in and back. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add sheet
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Sheet reads 19 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Sheet's tokens to change Sheet alone.
